decisions.rationale: Explore extreme frontiers: full SET_BASED minimizes logical I/O across loops, while moderate bulk collect with in-memory caching balances PGA and context switches without full absorption overhead.
Test intermediate batching and selective lookup caching without full absorption to balance PGA consumption and consistent gets across loops.

Explore intermediate batch sizes with SET_BASED balance updates, test selective caching of small lookup tables (s4 VAT rates), and evaluate mixed bulk processing trade-offs between memory footprint and logical I/O.
Explore low-memory lookup cache tradeoffs for s1 bulk variants and small static tax cache paired with bulk s5 to map the PGA/gets frontier.
Explore extreme trade-offs: full SET_BASED eliminates lookups and maximizes I/O efficiency, while bulk processing combined with selective caching balances PGA memory and logical reads.
Test SET_BASED for s5 paired with moderate bulk collection and targeted caching on s1 to balance PGA footprint with logical I/O reductions across intermediate Pareto trade-offs.
Test SET_BASED at s5 with varied BULK limits and selective caching at s1–s4 to explore balanced buffer cache vs PGA trade-offs.
Evaluate SET_BASED on s5 paired with ROW or smaller bulk variants on s1 with full caching to map low-memory vs low-IO trade-off boundaries.
Test fully set-based execution for maximum logical I/O reduction, followed by balanced bulk-processing with selective caching to explore diverse memory-I/O trade-off frontiers.
Evaluate SET_BASED at s1 combined with ROW/BULK_50 at s5, and explore selective lookup caching with moderate bulk batch sizes to optimize the logical I/O versus PGA trade-off.
Evaluate SET_BASED for s5 with cached lookups in s1 bulk loops, plus pure cached bulk configurations, exploring memory-read trade-offs.
Test selective caching with SET_BASED s5, and explore pure ROW/BULK_50 combinations without full lookup caching to optimize the low-PGA trade-off boundary.
Test diverse trade-offs: fully set-based execution minimizes logical I/O, balanced bulk processing explores moderate memory, and selective caching targets lookup-heavy hot spots.
Explore intermediate batch sizes combining partial caching to probe buffer gets vs PGA trade-offs, and complete the SET_BASED boundary for s1 and s5.
Explore intermediate bulk sizes with caching and SET_BASED s5, plus fully cached high-throughput bulk options to balance consistent gets and PGA memory.
Explore remaining Pareto candidates: s1=SET_BASED with s5=BULK_5000, and balanced bulk variants with selective lookup caches to minimize both buffer cache gets and PGA footprint.
Explore full SET_BASED execution for both DML loops to minimize consistent gets, plus balanced BULK collect configurations with selective caching across intermediate memory tradeoffs.
Explore intermediate batch sizes and selective lookup caching along the trade-off curve between logical I/O and PGA memory, plus set-based s1 with bulk s5 variants.
Test intermediate lookup caching tradeoffs combined with balanced bulk limits and set-based upsert to explore PGA/consistent-gets balance without full memory preloading.

Test SET_BASED at s1 combined with BULK_5000 at s5, explore mixed cache configurations under BULK_500/BULK_50, and evaluate low-memory ROW cursor lookups with cache to sample the Pareto boundary efficiently.
Explore the full SET_BASED extreme for optimal I/O, alongside balanced BULK collect batch sizes with selective lookup caching to evaluate memory versus consistent gets trade-offs.
Explore intermediate trade-offs: combine SET_BASED on s1 with ROW on s5, test BULK_500 with SQL lookups to save PGA, and evaluate selective caching with various bulk batch sizes.
Explore intermediate bulk and caching configurations targeting balanced PGA and buffer gets, testing SET_BASED on s5 with selective lookups and varying s1 bulk sizes.

Explore remaining Pareto candidates balancing I/O and PGA: combining cached lookups in s1 with low-footprint batching (BULK_50), testing ROW s1 with cached lookups, and checking large bulk options paired with lighter upsert configurations.
Evaluate SET_BASED across loops for minimal consistent gets, alongside balanced bulk processing with selective lookup caching to establish the bounds of the I/O versus PGA trade-off frontier.
Explore intermediate batch sizes with caching combinations and test SET_BASED at s1 paired with ROW at s5 to map remaining trade-off regions between I/O and PGA.
Explore intermediate bulk and lookup cache trade-offs for s1 combined with SET_BASED or varying bulk limits on s5 to span diverse PGA vs I/O points.
Explore selective lookup caching with bulk processing and mixed bulk/set-based combinations to balance buffer gets against PGA consumption along the frontier.
Test high-impact candidates across the trade-off: full set-based execution for lowest I/O, pure low-memory bulk operations, and intermediate bulk caching combinations.
Explore intermediate buffer cache vs PGA trade-offs using selective caching with moderate bulk sizes, plus set-based s1 paired with non-trivial s5 upsert alternatives.
Explore intermediate lookup cache combinations with BULK processing, evaluate SET_BASED s5 paired with low-overhead ROW/BULK_50 s1, and test SET_BASED s1 with minimal memory ROW s5.
Explore BULK_5000 and BULK_50 with selective caching and SET_BASED s5 to find optimal trade-offs between buffer cache reads and PGA usage across intermediate collection sizes.
Test SET_BASED across loops for extreme consistent gets reduction, alongside moderate bulk collect and caching trade-offs to balance PGA and logical reads.
Test full set-based s1 with ROW s5, explore aggressive BULK_5000 batching, and probe targeted caching combinations with mixed bulk levels to map the memory vs buffer cache trade-off.

Explores intermediate trade-offs between buffer cache reads and PGA usage by testing SET_BASED with BULK_50, selective small caches with SET_BASED upsert, and hybrid bulk-processing configurations across s1 and s5.
Explore intermediate PGA/logical-I/O trade-offs by pairing moderate BULK levels for both loops with full lookup caching, as well as pairing pure SQL lookups with SET_BASED upsert on s5.
Explore extreme trade-offs: fully set-based execution minimizes I/O and context switches; selective in-memory caching with bulk collection explores the memory-I/O boundary across both loops.

Test balanced memory/I-O tradeoffs combining SET_BASED with bulk/row variants, along with mixed cache configurations on moderate bulk sizes to explore the Pareto frontier between pure SQL and PL/SQL arrays.
Explores the remaining distinct SET_BASED s1 variant (with BULK_5000 s5) and samples selective lookup cache trade-offs combined with SET_BASED s5 to balance logical reads against PGA footprint.
Explores intermediate caching tradeoffs on s2-s4 with BULK_50/BULK_500 loops and SET_BASED upsert on s5 to balance logical reads against PGA memory.
